in_sanskrit.name: देवकुमार
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The name 'Devkumar' is derived from two Sanskrit words - 'Deva' (God) and 'Kumar' (son). This name is a common one in Hindu culture and signifies the son of a God.

in_hindi.name: देवकुमार
in_hindi.long_meaning: This name is the same in Hindi as it is in Sanskrit. It means 'God's son'.

in_tamil.name: தேவகுமார்
in_tamil.long_meaning: The Tamil translation of 'Devkumar' is 'Thiruvalar Kumar'. 'Thiruvalar' means 'God' and 'Kumar' means 'son'. So, this name translates to 'God's son' in Tamil.

in_telugu.name: దేవకూమార్
in_telugu.long_meaning: The Telugu translation of 'Devkumar' is 'Devakooamar'. 'Deva' in Telugu means 'God' and 'Kooamar' means 'son'. The long meaning of this name is 'God's son' or 'God's incarnation'.
